familySection.guest: Banye iji hazie profaịlụ ezinụlọ gị, ụmụaka, na njikọ di/nwunye.
familySection.hint: Tinye ụmụaka ma jikọọ di/nwunye gị. Nne na nna ọ bụla na-echekwa data CareMate nke ya.

account.title: Akaụntụ
account.deleteHint: Ọ na-ehichapụ data gị nkeonwe nke CareMate ma pụọ na ntinye aha kpamkpam. Akụkọ nlekọta nwere ike ịnọgide na-enweghị njirimara.
account.deleteConfirmMessage: Profaịlụ gị, kaadị mberede, njikọ ezinụlọ, na ngwaọrụ ahụike a ga-ehichapụ kpamkpam. Ị gaghị enwe ike ịbanye ọzọ. Ozi na akụkọ nwere ike ịnọgide dị ka Deleted user. A ga-akagbu ndenye aha dị ike ma ọ bụrụ na ọ ga-ekwe omume.
account.deleteSuccessMessage: Ehichapụla data gị nkeonwe nke CareMate. Ị nwere ike ịmepụta akaụntụ ọhụrụ oge ọ bụla jiri otu email.
